changelog:
- Initial release of self-hosted-ai: a deployment and operation assistant for self-hosted AI tools.
- Supports guidance for setting up Ollama, N8N, Open WebUI, Docker/Docker Compose, nginx reverse proxy, and HTTPS.
- Provides standard deployment instructions and troubleshooting steps for major components.
- Responds to common user requests for deploying local AI models and self-hosting AI tools.
summary: 自托管 AI 工具部署与运维助手。用于：(1) 在服务器上部署 Ollama（本地大模型）、N8N（自动化工作流）、Open WebUI 等 AI 工具，(2) 配置 Docker / Docker Compose 环境，(3) 管理模型下载和更新，(4) 排查服务故障，(5) 配置反向代理（nginx）和 HT...
